rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for creating or editing the layout of a document.

example.english: I can format your report for submission tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我幫你排版份報告，聽日交得㗎喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 nei5 paai4 baan2 fan6 bou3 gou3 ting1 jat6 gaau1 dak1 gaa3 laa3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a document layout, a presentation format, or a file format.

example.english: The format of this document needs to follow the company's requirements.
example.traditional: 呢份文件嘅格式要跟返公司要求。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 man4 gin6 ge3 gaak3 sik1 jiu3 gan1 faan1 gung1 si1 jiu1 kau4

rows.note: Use this when focusing on the general form or manner in which something is presented rather than its technical format.

example.english: We use an interview format to introduce this plan.
example.traditional: 我哋用訪問形式介紹呢個計劃。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jung6 fong2 man6 jing4 sik1 gaai3 siu6 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this specifically for the programming format or type of content broadcast by a radio or television programme.

example.english: The format of this radio programme is quite unusual.
example.traditional: 呢個電台節目形式幾特別。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 din6 toi4 zit3 muk6 jing4 sik1 gei2 dak6 bit6
